# mvstmt: hasBreak with break inside range and nested for
mv F:/BEGIN/+0,/END/-0 New
-- x.go --
package m

func F(items []int) int {
	total := 0
	// BEGIN
	for _, v := range items {
		for i := 0; i < v; i++ {
			if i > 5 {
				break
			}
			total += i
		}
	}
	// END
	return total
}
